title: Unexpected Visitor
next_chapter_hook: Before Chen Nian could finish speaking, the Tianji Record suddenly trembled violently, a crack appearing in the fourth layer of seals—the power sealed for years was awakening.

text.content: The night deepened into ink-black darkness, and the bamboo grove at Tianqing Sect Back Mountain rustled in the cold wind. The pale cold glow emanating from the Jade Pendant beside Su Qingyao's pillow continued to persist, while Chen Ji leaned against an ancient pine branch three zhang away, observing all of this. His fingertips gently stroked the incomplete Tianji Record in his arms, his brow slightly furrowed—the frequency of this light had produced a faint resonance with something long dormant in the depths of his bloodline.

Night Qing's presence suddenly shifted, his demonic aura swirling like a deep abyss. The demonic path saint was previously in meditative contemplation, but now abruptly opened his eyes, with demonic energy revolving within his pupils like a vortex. "We have a guest," he whispered, his voice extremely low, as his fair hand silently conjured a delicate purple demonic mist. "Very close, and...very familiar." Chen Ji remained motionless, merely expanding the Tianji Record's perception range to capture every subtle Spiritual Energy fluctuation in the surrounding area.

dialogue.content: Night Qing's form flickered slightly, positioning herself half a step before Chen Ji, with demonic path mist swirling around her. "Come out. I know you're there." Her tone was ice-cold yet carried a complex undertone. "The tracking techniques of the Holy Sect, I can still recognize."

text.content: Between the swaying bamboo shadows, a slender figure gradually emerged from the moonlit darkness. She wore a simple Gray Robe, her hair casually pinned up with a wooden hairpin. Her delicate features bore the rough texture of long-term wind and frost erosion. What drew the most attention was the faint golden pattern between her brows—a mark from the same source as the dormant power in Chen Ji's bloodline.

dialogue.content: "Brother." The woman softly called, her voice trembling slightly, her eyes red-rimmed but stubbornly holding back tears. "Long time no see." Chen Ji's fingers tightened around the Tianji Record. His face remained calm as that useless-looking person, but his heart was churning with immense waves. Ten years had passed—ten entire years—he believed she had long been killed by those madmen of the Holy Sect.

text.content: Night Qing's demonic mist suddenly surged, dangerous killing intent弥漫在空气中："Chen Nian? Heavenly Fate Lock Key?" she coldly laughed, "The people of the Holy Sect dare show themselves here." Chen Nian did not look at her, her gaze always fixed on Chen Ji, those eyes filled with too many complex emotions—guilt, heartache, and a trace of indescribable remorse.

dialogue.content: "I've come to fulfill the promise to your father, and to warn you." Chen Nian took a deep breath, trying to steady her voice. "The Holy Sect has already sensed the Spiritual Energy fluctuation of the Tianji Record. The people they sent arrived before me, secretly infiltrating Tianqing Sect. Ling Yuan...he has a deal with the Holy Sect."

text.content: Chen Ji internally coldly smiled—he already knew about Ling Yuan's secret dealings with the Holy Sect. The old fox had been scheming for decades, how could he not have a backup plan? But on the surface, he still wore that wooden expression, scratching his head: "Sister, what are you talking about? What Tianji Record, what Holy Sect?" Chen Nian looked at his act, her eyes grew redder, but she laughed through tears: "Brother, even now, you're still pretending."

"I'm not pretending." Chen Ji sighed. "I've just gotten used to it." The moment his words fell, Chen Nian suddenly stepped forward, pressing her hand against Chen Ji's wrist. In that instant, a strange blood resonance like an electric current surged through both their bodies, and the Tianji Record in Chen Ji's arms suddenly blazed with dazzling golden light, resonating with the golden pattern between Chen Nian's brows.

That feeling was indescribable—as if two diverging rivers of the same source had finally reconverged, a long-dormant restriction within Chen Ji was triggered, and a majestic and familiar power was slowly awakening. It was his father's aura, desolate, heavy, carrying the resolve to face death without fear. "Father..." he murmured, his throat somewhat choked.

dialogue.content: "Can you feel it?" Chen Nian's tears finally fell, her voice trembling. "The thing Father sealed within you is awakening." She tightly gripped Chen Ji's hand. "He used the very last of his Heavenly Fate Value to seal this power into your bloodline. He told me to pass on to you—'The Tianji Record is the key, the bloodline is the lock. When the key opens the lock, you will understand everything.'"

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes, and the Tianji Record's perception became unprecedentedly clear at this moment. He "saw" the scene before his father's death—the man hunted by the entire world, covered in blood, trembling as he handed a bundle-wrapped infant to an old man, then with his final strength, drew a golden talisman on the infant's heart.

choice.prompt: Faced with the truth left by his father and the awakened power, how should Chen Ji choose?

choices.description: Proactively guide the Tianji Record and bloodline power resonance, unseal the power left by his father, but will expose his aura and bring Holy Sect pursuit
choices.visible_cost: Consume Heavenly Fate Value 10 points, may expose location
choices.visible_reward: Bloodline power partially awakens, gains father's遗留的 combat experience memories
choices.risk_hint: Holy Sect pursuers may immediately lock onto location

text.content: Chen Ji did not hesitate. He gripped Chen Nian's wrist in return, his voice deep: "Since Father wanted it to awaken, then let it awaken." The Tianji Record and bloodline power fused perfectly at this moment, a scalding heat flow spreading from his heart to his limbs, countless scenes flooding his mind like a carousel—the father's lifetime of combat experience, his understanding of the Tianji Record, and...a shocking secret.

choices.memory_label: 兄妹血脉共鸣，心意相通

choices.text: Suppress and Wait for the Right Moment
choices.description: Re-seal the awakened power, choose a more stable moment, but may betray Father's last wish

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcibly suppressing the boiling power back. "Not now." His voice was low but firm. "The people from the Holy Sect are nearby. Awakening now would be walking into a trap." A flash of loss appeared in Chen Nian's eyes, but was quickly replaced by understanding: "Father indeed did not misjudge you. You are more composed than anyone."

choices.memory_label: 兄妹暂时未能完全理解彼此

text.content: Night Qing stood to the side, watching this reunion scene of the separated siblings. The demonic path saint's cold hard expression actually showed a trace of emotion. She lightly coughed, breaking this moment of warmth: "The Holy Sect's reinforcements will arrive by noon tomorrow at the latest. Your time for reunion is running out." Chen Nian nodded, taking a yellowed Jade Slip from her arms and handing it to Chen Ji: "This is the other half Father left me. Now it's time to return it to its rightful owner."

dialogue.content: Night Qing raised an eyebrow at the Jade Slip: "The Heavenly Fate Lock Key actually carries something like this on her? Does the Holy Sect know their treasure has been swapped?" Chen Nian淡淡一笑, that smile carrying a hint of mockery: "Does the Holy Sect think using me as a tool gives them peace of mind? How laughable." Her gaze turned to Chen Ji, "Brother, these ten years in the Holy Sect, I endured humiliation and hardship all for today."

text.content: Chen Ji took the Jade Slip. The moment his fingertip touched the jade surface, a mournful aura flooded his consciousness through his palm—the final obsession and unwillingness of his father before death. He closed his eyes, silently digesting this emotional current. When he opened his eyes again, they had recovered their usual calmness and depth. "Thank you, Xiao Nian," he said softly. "Father did not misjudge you, and I will not let you return to that hell again."

choice.prompt: Faced with his sister's ten years of sacrifice and dedication, how should Chen Ji respond?

choices.description: Promise that from now on, you will not let your sister bear any hardship alone, even if it means becoming an enemy of the world
choices.visible_reward: Chen Nian's trust greatly increases, may unlock special bond skills
choices.risk_hint: Over-promising may affect future decision space

text.content: Chen Ji stepped forward, gently pulling Chen Nian into an embrace. This hug came too late, late by a full ten years. "From now on," his voice was low but firm, "no one will dare touch a single hair on your head. Not the Holy Sect, not Ling Yuan, not even the Heavenly Eye." Chen Nian buried her face in his shoulder, the grievances suppressed for ten years finally turning into silent tears.

choices.memory_label: 十年离散后的重逢，兄妹之情更加深厚

choices.text: Plan Revenge on the Holy Sect
choices.description: Transform sorrow into power, jointly plan a comprehensive revenge plan against the Holy Sect with your sister
choices.visible_reward: Gain intelligence network Chen Nian built over ten years in the Holy Sect, allowing for more thorough planning

text.content: Chen Ji gathered his emotions, a cold and fierce light flickering in his eyes: "What the Holy Sect owes us, I will make them repay a hundredfold." Chen Nian wiped her tears, her lips curling into a cold smile identical to his: "These ten years, I've collected all the weaknesses of the Holy Sect. Their intelligence network, hidden agent distributions, even everyone's weaknesses...Brother, I remember everything."
